dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline, transitioning from a vertical orientation near the apex to a horizontal trajectory at the posterior insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a broad pixel radius, lacking any acute or sharp geometric vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin rises at a steep, nearly linear angle of approximately 50 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible longitudinal base width is approximately 1.75 times the maximum vertical height from the dorsal midline to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular white mottling and light-colored patches visible on the lateral flank and the lower portion of the dorsal fin, suggestive of skin trauma or species-specific scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast speckled pigmentation pattern distributed across the dark epidermal surface of the visible dorsal area.
